appsView.addingAppsFollowProgress: Adding apps: follow progress in the terminal.
appsView.noAppsYetUse: No apps yet: use "Add app" to scaffold one and get a live preview.
appsView.noVitestProjectsFound: No test projects found: nothing here owns a vitest.config.*, bunfig.toml or *.test.* file.
appsView.openPreviewInNew: Open {app} preview in a new tab

dependenciesView.noWorkspacePackagesFound: No workspace packages found: pnpm-workspace.yaml names no package dirs.

findings.heading: What the code says
findings.none: Nothing to report: every runtime dependency is used by code it ships, and no two areas depend on each other.

unused.title: Declared, never used
unused.caption: Runtime dependencies nothing in the package imports or names. Remove them from package.json.

toolingOnly.title: Runtime dependency, used only by tests or tooling
toolingOnly.caption: Only tests, scripts or config files use these. Move them to devDependencies.

mutual.title: {from} → {to}, against the flow
mutual.caption: {count} edge runs this way, {against} the other. The lighter direction is usually the one out of place. | {count} edges run this way, {against} the other. The lighter direction is usually the one out of place.

matrix.heading: Areas against areas
matrix.caption: Each row depends on each column, counting runtime edges. Areas are ordered foundation first, so numbers right of the diagonal point against the usual flow; an outlined cell is the lighter half of a pair that depends both ways. Select a cell to list its edges, or an area to open it in the graph.

usageTable.heading: How declared dependencies are used
usageTable.caption: Read from each package's own files: the strongest use found decides.

usageAbout.code: A shipped file imports a value from it.
usageAbout.types: Shipped files import only its types, which erase at build time.
usageAbout.reference: Nothing imports it, but a shipped file names it, like a Dockerfile copying its build.
usageAbout.tooling: Only tests, scripts and config files use it.
usageAbout.none: Nothing in the package names it.

graph.hubTitle: {name}: {count} packages depend on it at runtime. Shown as a mark on each card instead of a line.
graph.empty: No edges to draw with these settings.

inspector.reach: Everything it reaches through its dependencies, and everything a change to it can affect.

inside.declared: Directories stacked in the layers its layers.json declares, lowest at the bottom. A module may import its own layer and any layer below it.
inside.inferred: Directories stacked by their imports: a directory that imports nothing here sits at the bottom, and each one sits above everything it imports.
inside.upward: Imports that reach up a layer
inside.upwardCaption: The package's boundary check refuses these unless they are on its baseline.
inside.unplaced: No layer places: {units}. Add them to layers.json.
inside.declareHint: Add a layers.json next to this package's package.json to name its layers. Then this view shows any import that goes against them.
